resources.string: No chess engine is installed. Pragma Chess analyses with an engine installed as a separate app, the way DroidFish and other chess apps do (Open Exchange).
There is already a database with that name.
Delete “%1$s” and its games from this phone? Games already sent to a computer stay there.

On your computer open Options ▸ Connect Mobile App… in Pragma Chess and scan the code it shows. The databases of the phone and of every computer become one collection, kept the same everywhere: what you save here reaches your computers, and what the phone learns from one computer it brings to the others.
Scan the code in Options ▸ Connect Mobile App… on your computer
That is not a Pragma Chess pairing code.
Forget %1$s? Its databases stay on this phone, which keeps bringing them to your other computers. To connect again, scan the code once more.
No connection to the internet relays. Check that the phone is online.
The computer did not answer. Is Pragma Chess open on the computer, and is this phone still connected in Options ▸ Connect Mobile App…?
This phone was disconnected from %1$s. Scan the code in Options ▸ Connect Mobile App… to connect it again.
The computer answered, but a connection could not be made across these networks. Try with both on the same Wi-Fi.
The sync with %1$s stopped before the end. Try again.
Waiting for the computer to answer…
How the computer lists this phone.
A companion to Pragma Chess on the desktop: your databases on the phone, games played here sent to the computer. Free and open source.
By David L. Brown, distributed as freeware; the SVG files come from the lichess project.
The move list figurines, from SkakNew-Figurine by Ulrich Dirr (LaTeX Project Public License 1.2), renamed Pragma Figurine.
AndroidX and Jetpack Compose, OkHttp, ZXing and ZXing Android Embedded, secp256k1-kmp (Apache License 2.0); WebRTC (BSD 3-Clause, via stream-webrtc-android, Apache 2.0); libsecp256k1 (MIT).
